create_ernie_image_pipeline: create an ErnieImagePipeline instance for text-to-image generation with configurable modules
load_ernie_image_modules: load text_encoder, tokenizer, vae, transformer, scheduler modules with optional PE model support
build_ernie_image_stages: build pipeline stages including input validation, prompt enhancement, text encoding, denoising, and decoding
read_tokenizer_max_length: read model_max_length from tokenizer_config.json for a local or HuggingFace Hub model path
resolve_pe_tokenizer_path: resolve the directory containing PE tokenizer files from component_paths or model subdirectories
